entities.name: Eimutis Misiūnas
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Eimutis Misiūnas is a Lithuanian jurist and politician, Minister of Interior of Lithuania from 2016 to 2019. He was a teacher at Mykolas Romeris University and at the International School of Law and Business. He was a judge of Vilnius city court. Misiūnas is an expert in police law. He is a graduate of the Lithuanian Police Academy.

entities.summary: Eimutis Misiūnas is a Lithuanian jurist and politician, Minister of Interior of Lithuania from 2016 to 2019. He was a teacher at Mykolas Romeris University and at the International School of Law and Business. He was a judge of Vilnius city court. Misiūnas is an expert in police law. He is a graduate of the Lithuanian Police Academy.
